high_level_description: The image features a close-up of a sign with the logo of Meta, the company formerly known as Facebook. The logo consists of the word "Meta" in black letters with a blue infinity symbol preceding it. The sign is illuminated from behind, creating a soft glow around the logo. Below the image, there is a headline that reads: "South Korea fines Meta for illegal collection of user data." The source of the news is indicated by the logo of "The New Indian Express," which is a well-known news publication.
